description: Tinarelli, Roberto and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. This project dataset relates instrument-transformer performance to controlled test conditions. File descriptors identify voltage/current calibration components from TUBITAK, temperature/burden tests from TUD, current and Rogowski-coil tests from PTB, adjacent-phase/proximity tests from INRIM, temperature/humidity tests from Bologna and temperature/vibration tests from LNE. Coverage is this multi-institution experimental bundle. The separate LNE spreadsheet deposit is retained as an overlapping component; exact waveform identity is not established. Parameter ranges and sample intervals vary and are not inferred from archive names. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The measurement collection supports power quality calibration of instrument transformers.
